target_customer: Independent retailers in Indian metro neighbourhoods (grocery, pharmacy, stationery, gifts) who offer same-day delivery today using their own staff or ad-hoc couriers.
competitors: Hyperlocal courier apps such as Dunzo-style on-demand riders (unverified, from general knowledge)
Aggregator platforms with their own delivery fleets such as Swiggy Instamart or Zepto (unverified)
Shops continuing to deliver with their own staff or a regular local rider
failure_reasons: Route pooling only saves money when several shops in the same neighbourhood join; early on there is too little density to beat a shop's own rider.
Shops are used to informal arrangements and may not pay a monthly subscription for something they already do for free with existing staff.
Courier capacity is the real cost. If rider availability or quality is inconsistent, shops will lose customers and blame the service.

compliance_flags.note: Engaging riders may bring state-level labour and social-security obligations. Verify with official sources; this is not legal advice.
Handling customer addresses and phone numbers falls under India's data protection rules. Verify with official sources; this is not legal advice.
A subscription service has GST registration and invoicing implications. Verify with official sources; this is not legal advice.

market_saturation.justification: Well-funded delivery aggregators and courier apps already serve the same shops.

operational_complexity.justification: Routing, rider supply and handoffs across several shops must work every day.

compliance.justification: Rider engagement and customer data handling need checking, but no licence is obviously blocking.

capital_need.justification: Software is cheap; guaranteeing courier capacity before shops sign up is not.

founder_load.justification: A single founder would carry sales, operations and rider management at once.

suggested_pivots: Start with one dense neighbourhood and 10 to 15 shops, with riders paid per delivery and no fixed capacity.
Sell route planning software only, and let shops keep using their own riders.
Focus on one category, such as pharmacies, where same-day delivery matters most.
